sections.headline: Get ready for the way business records are changing
body: Making Tax Digital
Digital record keeping already matters for VAT and now applies to some sole traders and landlords under Making Tax Digital for Income Tax.
Clarentis lists MTD-ready records and MTD setup among its services, so the first conversation can include what applies to you, what records are needed and how software fits the process.
HMRC rules depend on your circumstances. This page is general information, not tax advice.

sections.headline: Straight answers to practical questions
body: Before you enquire
The free consultation is the place to confirm the exact scope. These answers cover the published starting point.

questions.question: Is the first consultation free?
questions.answer: Yes. Clarentis publishes a free initial consultation. It is used to understand your business, deadlines, current records and the support you need before a proposal is prepared.

questions.question: Are the published prices guaranteed?
questions.answer: No. They are indicative ranges. The final fixed fee depends on the agreed scope, transaction volume and complexity.

questions.question: Can I ask about more than one service?
questions.answer: Yes. Choose the closest service in the form and describe the wider picture in your message. The scope review can cover connected bookkeeping, payroll, VAT and tax work.

questions.question: Do my books need to be up to date before I enquire?
questions.answer: No. Explain what is in place and what feels overdue or unclear. The consultation is designed to establish the current position and the next practical step.
